mapper.select: SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Timestamp) AS timestamp, TraceId AS traceId, SpanId AS spanId, SeverityText AS severity, ServiceName AS service, Body AS body, ResourceAttributes AS resourceAttributes FROM quasar_tracing.logs WHERE TraceId = #{traceId} ORDER BY Timestamp

SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, toIntervalSecond(#{stepSec})))) * 1000 AS time, SeverityText AS severity, toUInt64(count()) AS count FROM quasar_tracing.logs
GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time

SELECT toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Timestamp) AS timestamp, TraceId AS traceId, SpanId AS spanId, SeverityText AS severity, ServiceName AS service, Body AS body, ResourceAttributes AS resourceAttributes FROM quasar_tracing.logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) AND SeverityText IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL') ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT ${limit}
